prefix: Use the attached reference screenshots ONLY as the art style reference (rendering technique, line work, shading, color saturation, character proportions). Do NOT copy their characters, items, layout, logos or text. Create new art for a mobile merge-2 game called Bloom Corner: a sunny small-town concept store with a flower corner, a small cafe counter and a fashion rack. ART STYLE:

merge-glossy-cartoon.style: glossy painted cartoon style of top merge-2 games, like the references: bold rounded shapes, high color saturation, strong glossy highlights and soft shadows on items, thin dark outlines, characters painted (not line art) with big expressive eyes and wide confident smiles, warm sunny lighting with rim light, orange, yellow and turquoise accents.

cute-doodle-merge.style: cute doodle / chibi style, like the references: clean uniform dark-brown outlines, flat colors with minimal soft shading, muted pastel palette (cream, peach, mint, soft pink), chibi proportions for characters (big head, small body, simple eyes, blush), chunky simple items like stickers, cozy hand-drawn feeling.

warm-painterly-storybook.style: warm painterly storybook style, like the references: soft hand-painted textures, visible gentle brush strokes, warm golden ambient light, cozy European cafe aesthetic, characters stylized with natural proportions (about 6 heads tall) and soft outlines, items with painterly detail but simple readable silhouettes.

drama-3d-cinematic.style: polished stylized 3D-rendered cinematic style, like the references: stylized 3D characters with smooth realistic skin shading and glossy hair, soft dramatic studio lighting, shallow depth of field, items rendered as glossy 3D objects, cinematic drama mood.

webtoon-semireal-drama.style: webtoon semi-realistic style, like the references: glamorous attractive characters with realistic proportions, detailed glossy hair and makeup, fashion-magazine look, soft digital painting, items glossy and luxurious with pink and purple accents, romance drama mood.
